checks.command: Parse actual workerd event lines; assert exact key allowlist and outcome counts; reject private cookie/wallet/signature/source strings

acceptance: Actual Node createApp with a canonical wallet and origin-scoped hashed session emits6 observations for2 deduplicated consent effects, including accepted/replayed/refused and replay after revoke remains disabled.

Trusted response pending/refused labels override 503; generic 5xx stays transport-unknown. 202 classification, untrusted request outcome header ignored, original handler error identity, sink rejection isolation and non-allowlisted route passthrough.
Streaming request and response bodies remain unused, unlocked by the observer and not pulled; no body/header/query data enters event output.
Actual production Worker ran under local workerd/D1 and emitted7 console JSON events:3 accepted,1 replayed,3 refused. This is captured runtime log evidence, not a mocked Worker logger assertion.
Strict event key allowlist has no wallet, cookie, signature, arbitrary query/body, error text or raw correlation.

Actual Node Earn campaign without staffing emits pending/dependency (503), invalid URL emits refused, staffed retained-price admission emits accepted, exact retry replayed and body conflict refused: five observations for one committed admission. No service mocks.
limits: Observed request event coverage only; not complete historical admission or actual external-call accounting.
Seeded session rows exercise genuine canonical-cookie authentication; this test does not claim a wallet signing flow.
202/generic 5xx/throw cases use isolated observer inputs; actual Node Earn verifies pending/accepted/replayed/refused, and actual Node/Worker consent verifies accepted/replayed/refused.
No backend edits, external delivery, signing, broadcast or financial execution.
